title: Glowing planet with rings
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='planetGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#ffaa33'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cc5500'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='ringGrad' x1='0%' y1='0%' x2='100%' y2='0%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#44ddff'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#88eeff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#22aadd'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id='glow'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='1.5' result='blur'/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in='blur'/>
        <feMergeNode in='SourceGraphic'/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ring back half -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='44' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='5' opacity='0.7' filter='url(#glow)' transform='rotate(-18 50 52)'/>

  <!-- Planet body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='26' fill='url(#planetGrad)' filter='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Planet highlight -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='38' r='9' fill='#fff8cc' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- Planet surface bands -->
  <path d='M27 44 Q50 50 73 44' fill='none' stroke='#ffcc55' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M29 54 Q50 59 71 54' fill='none' stroke='#dd7700' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Ring front half -->
  <path d='M8 56 Q50 76 92 56' fill='none' stroke='url(#ringGrad)' stroke-width='5' opacity='0.9' filter='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- Ring sparkles -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='60' r='1.5' fill='#ccffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='59' r='1.5' fill='#ccffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='68' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='68' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Stars -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='22' r='1.5' fill='#aaddff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='38' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='12' cy='35' r='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
